requirements.detail: Treat route_target as canonical navigation identity and keep serialized transport narrower than internal route model.
Use a controlled object_kind enum spanning conversational, runtime, and orchestration-rewrite objects.
inspector_target must be a small closed vocabulary and never a free-form extension bag.
subject_id is only for doc/artifact renderable subjects; all other routed identities use object_kind plus object_id.
Normalize usage, wizard resume, chat search, node detail, and attempt detail into canonical object-first route recipes.
Normalize blocked_episode, scheduler_pass, safe_point, remediation, graph_generation, and graph_patch through object-first routes.
Normalize worktree, lane, feature_seam, work_package, concern, and promotion pivots through object-first routing.
Route contract must include invalid-combination rejection rules (missing project, competing selectors, incomplete object selector, invalid inspector/tab/state fields).
tab_id is stable page-tab focus only, not object identity and not shell/panel/workspace/browser tab identity.
Keep base contract small and handle scoped identity resolution through resolver context (project_id, focused_run_id, canonical stores).

decisions.decision: resume_url is serialized transport; route_target remains canonical identity.
Adopt canonical object_kind enum including thread/message/wizard/usage_event/run-lineage and rewrite orchestration objects.
Adopt closed inspector_target enum: summary, evidence, artifacts, history, reviews, usage, lineage, details.
Freeze subject_id to doc/artifact and route everything else through object_kind/object_id.
Treat invalid route payload combinations as contract failures rather than best-effort fallbacks.

data_shapes.shape: object_kind enum includes thread, message, wizard, usage_event, run, node, attempt, scheduler_pass, blocked_episode, safe_point, remediation, feature_seam, work_package, lane, worktree, concern, promotion, graph_patch, graph_generation.
inspector_target enum includes summary, evidence, artifacts, history, reviews, usage, lineage, details.
subject_id families are restricted to doc:<document_id> and artifact:<artifact_id>.
tab_id role is stable page-tab focus with Orchestrator family values: progress, seams, node_graph, evidence, history, ledger.

routing_rules.rule: usage routes normalize through object_kind=usage_event and canonical object_id, with inspector_target or tab selection as secondary.
wizard/message navigation is object-first; deep-link step/message anchors stay serialized secondary detail.
Runtime lineage objects route by object identity with focused_run_id scope; avoid attempt-only or tier-era pivots.
Source control and orchestration pivots route by worktree/lane/seam/package/concern/promotion object identity.
A valid route has project_id and one primary selector; reject competing subject and object selectors.

verification_rules.rule: Reject object_kind without object_id and object_id without object_kind.
Reject inspector_target when no object selector exists.
Reject tab_id values that conflict with target_kind or non-page-tab contexts.
Reject line/range and per-surface local state in route_target.

owner_consumer_obligations.obligation: Own route_target primitives, selector precedence, validation/rejection rules, scoped resolver rules, and resume_url serialization rule.
Declare primitive ownership and mark storage/surface docs as consumers of navigation identity.
Classify commands and normalize wrappers/aliases to route_target and OpenSubject payloads.

owner_consumer_obligations.owner: FinalGUISpec, storage-plan, usage-feature, assistant-chat-design, Run_Graph_View, Orchestrator_Page
owner_consumer_obligations.obligation: Consume canonical route vocabulary and stop introducing stronger local deep-link or ad hoc identity fields.

stale_retirement_items.item: Retire tier_id-led route pivots in favor of canonical object_kind identities.
Retire usage_event_ref as special top-level route field; normalize to object_kind=usage_event.
Retire attempt-only history assumptions for scheduler/blocked/remediation lineage flows.
Retire conflation of page tabs, panel subviews, and shell/workspace/browser tabs under route tab_id.

open_questions.question: Should blocked_episode scope semantics be codified as explicit resolver algorithm text in Contracts_V0 or delegated to runtime docs?
Beyond the Orchestrator tab family, which additional tab enums are stable enough for canonical tab_id expansion?

process_defects.defect: Core route ownership text lagged behind concrete wizard and runtime flow behavior, causing stronger implicit contracts outside owner docs.
Prior route guidance emphasized positive examples without hard rejection rules, enabling payload drift.

doc_hints.hint: Add canonical object_kind and inspector_target enums with explicit non-goals.
Update usage-feature and assistant-chat-design to use object-first route examples.
Embed runtime-lineage and orchestration route recipes in Run_Graph_View and Orchestrator_Page.
Document validator rejection cases and resolver scope rules in Contracts_V0 and Crosswalk.
